7032.title: Catalog discovery creates short-lived Claude helpers
7032.rootCauseOneLine: Separate process-local model and command caches each invoke a short-lived SDK initialization helper on a miss; the downstream Windows behavior remains unverified.
7032.proposedFix: Reproduce Windows interop first, then evaluate context-safe initialization reuse or provider-specific probe reduction with a failing regression.
7032.caveats: Two clean Linux runs verified startup counts of 2, 2, 4, 6 using the real SDK and a synthetic CLI endpoint. No Windows/WSL console, registry activity, Antigravity behavior, or exact cadence was reproduced. The complete test is inline in the report.
